title: Find length of Loop in Linked List
description:
Given a linked list of size N. The task is to complete the function countNodesinLoop() that checks whether a given Linked List contains a loop or not and if the loop is present then return the number of nodes in the loop, else return 0.

Input Format:
First line: n c (c is 1-based loop connect index, or 0 if no loop)
Second line: n space-separated node values

Output Format:
Number of nodes in the loop (or 0)
